title: Patient acuity calculation, nurse assignment, and end-of-shift reporting (P15, Session 1)
goal: Use Claude to calculate accurate patient acuity scores for a 17-patient nursing-unit census, assign nurses to patients based on those scores, audit the assignment for safety/workload issues, manage a mid-shift nurse-coverage disruption (RN-4 escorting a transferred patient off the floor), and produce a final end-of-shift report for the charge nurse.

Step-1.step_name: Calculate patient acuity from a census of patients.
Step-1.step_action: Review and compare patients in the census and assign an acuity # for each. List the patients by order of room numbers.

nodes.label: Define task and supply patient census to Claude
nodes.detail: Opens a new Claude chat, uploads the nursing-assignment census spreadsheet (17 patients), and types a prompt asking Claude to calculate accurate patient acuity scores and list patients in room-number order.
nodes.softwares: Claude (web chat); Windows File Explorer (file upload)

nodes.label: Ingest census and reconcile acuity scores
nodes.detail: Lists the uploaded file, loads its xlsx skill, inspects the spreadsheet's acuity scoring fields, and recalculates the Acuity Score formula (Safety+Medical+Intervention+Room Location+Isolation+Discharge) for all 17 patients, confirming tiers (5 Level5/8 Level4/4 Level3, total 148) and that the existing RN assignment already satisfies the RN-1/RN-4 staffing rules.

nodes.label: Review delivered acuity table
nodes.detail: Reads through Claude's in-chat per-patient acuity table and tier summary before deciding to request a formatted file deliverable.

nodes.label: Request formatted acuity report deliverable
nodes.detail: Asks Claude to produce the patient acuity report sorted by room number and save it as a named file (patientacuity.xlsx).

nodes.label: Build and verify patient acuity Excel report
nodes.detail: Writes a build script producing a formula-driven XLSX (not hardcoded), color-coded by acuity tier with a summary block; runs recalculation, spot-checks cell values, and delivers patientacuity.xlsx sorted 101-118.

nodes.label: Review the patient acuity Excel report

user_response.label: adopt
user_response.reasoning:
Source a1: Requets acuity scores and list patients by room number. 
Target a5: outputs patientacuity.xlsx sorted by room
Reasoning: a4 asks a1's result as a file/report, user accepts a5

Step-2.step_name: Audit acuity scores and assign nurses to patients.
Step-2.step_action: List each nurse and assigned patients with acuity scores. List total column for acuity of all patients per nurse.

nodes.label: Prepare nurse-audit request
nodes.detail: Composes the next prompt over several minutes: browses the '+' Add-to-project/attachment menu, opens a Windows file-picker dialog and selects an (unrelated) parent-consent docx to attach alongside patientacuity.xlsx, and finishes typing the request to audit acuity scores and assign nurses with per-nurse totals before sending it.
nodes.softwares: Claude (web chat); Windows File Explorer (file picker)

nodes.label: Verify inputs, build, and deliver nurse assignment audit
nodes.detail: Checks the uploaded files, identifies the parent-consent document as unrelated, and re-confirms the acuity data from the nursing files. Builds the nurse assignment audit with patient assignments, COUNTIF/SUMIF-based nurse totals, and automated rule checks, recalculates and verifies that all totals reconcile (17 patients, 148 total acuity), and delivers the completed nurse-assignment-audit.xlsx with all four checks passing.

nodes.label: Review nurse assignment audit results
nodes.detail: Reads through the delivered nurse-assignment-audit.xlsx in the embedded viewer — the per-nurse Nurse Totals table and the Assignment Rule Audit section confirming all four checks pass — before moving to the next step.

user_response.label: adopt
user_response.reasoning:
Source b1: Requests acuity audit and nurse assignments with per nurse totals
Target b2: Outputs nurse-assignment-audit.xlsx with totals and rule checks
Reasoning: User accepts b2

Step-3.step_name: Review and test the nurse assignment for bottlenecks or failures.
Step-3.step_action: Find at least 3 safety or medical issues that may need to be addressed. Decide if they warrant reassignment of the nurses.

nodes.label: Request stress-test and safety audit of assignment
nodes.detail: After briefly checking the workflow-planning task instructions for this step, asks Claude to review and test the nurse-assignment audit file for bottlenecks or failures and find at least 3 safety/medical issues, deciding whether they warrant reassignment.

nodes.label: Stress-test formulas and conduct clinical safety review
nodes.detail: Runs two robustness tests (a reassignment recalculation, and a data-entry fragility test injecting a whitespace typo into a nurse label) confirming the formulas are sound but fragile to typos; then performs a clinical review identifying three issues: RN-2's 100% Level-5/isolation concentration risk, RN-3's highest-census workload bottleneck with same-day discharges, and Room 104's critical-patient clustering under RN-2. Proposes two rebalancing swaps.

nodes.label: Review clinical safety findings and recommended swaps
nodes.detail: Briefly glances at the Google Docs workflow-planning template again, then reads through Claude's full three-issue clinical/safety review (RN-2 isolation concentration, RN-3 workload bottleneck, Room 104 critical-patient clustering) and the two proposed rebalancing swaps before responding.

nodes.label: Approve proposed nurse reassignment swaps
nodes.detail: Confirms ('yes') that Claude should implement the proposed RN-2/RN-5 and RN-3/RN-1 patient swaps into an updated, re-audited Excel file.

nodes.label: Build and verify rebalanced nurse assignment
nodes.detail: Implements the two safety swaps (Room 109↔113 and Room 110 RN-3→RN-1), catches and fixes a unit-mismatch bug in its own 'overload' audit formula, adds two new audit checks (isolation concentration, overload), verifies all six checks pass, and delivers nurse-assignment-audit-rebalanced.xlsx.

nodes.label: Review rebalanced audit and preview Step 4 requirements
nodes.detail: After Claude delivers the rebalanced audit workbook, switches to the Google Docs workflow-planning template to read Step 4's rubric (the RN-4 mid-shift disruption scenario) while the build finishes, then returns to Claude to scroll through the rebalanced spreadsheet in detail (Nurse Totals, isolation-load and overload checks, clicking through individual cells) before starting the next request.

user_response.label: adopt
user_response.reasoning:
Source c1: Requests a safety/medical issue check and reassignment decision
Target c5: Outputs nurse-assignment-audit-rebalanced.xlsx with c2's changes applied
Reasoning: c2 proposes changes, c4 approves, user accepts c5.

Step-4.step_name: Respond to a mid-shift change: RN-4's patient becomes hypotensive and is transferred out; RN-4 escorts and is off the floor 45 minutes.
Step-4.step_action: Recalculate acuity scores and nurse assignments. Cover for RN-4.

nodes.label: Introduce mid-shift disruption scenario
nodes.detail: Describes RN-4's most stable patient (Room 108) becoming severely hypotensive and being transferred to a higher level of care, with RN-4 escorting the transfer and off the floor for ~45 minutes; requests recalculated mid-shift patient acuity and nurse assignment reports.

nodes.label: Recalculate mid-shift acuity and build temporary coverage plan
nodes.detail: Updates the mid-shift census after Room 108 transfers to a higher level of care, reducing the active census from 17 to 16 patients and total acuity from 148 to 142. Rebalances RN-4's remaining patients during her absence by temporarily assigning them to RN-1 and RN-5, fixes an audit-formula bug that incorrectly counted the 'OFF FLOOR' marker as a patient, verifies all mid-shift checks pass, and delivers the updated acuity and nurse-assignment files.

nodes.label: Review mid-shift coverage plan
nodes.detail: Reads through the delivered mid-shift patient-acuity and nurse-assignment-audit files (RN-4 off-floor status, temporary Room 115/116 coverage split) before requesting the return-to-floor versions.

user_response.label: adopt
user_response.reasoning:
Source d1: Requests mid-shift acuity and assignment reports while RN4 is off floor.
Target d2: Outputs mid-shift acuity and assignment audit files with temp RN-1/RN-5 coverage.
Reasoning: User reviews d2 and accepts.

nodes.label: Request reports for RN-4's return to the floor
nodes.detail: Asks Claude to run the same two reports again for when RN-4 returns to the floor.

nodes.label: Revert temporary coverage and verify restored caseload
nodes.detail: Builds return-to-floor versions of the acuity and assignment-audit reports, reverting Rooms 115/116 back to RN-4 (now 2 patients since Room 108 does not return), replaces an unreliable strict tie-check with a clinically meaningful average-based check, verifies values reconcile (16 patients/142 acuity), and delivers both files.

nodes.label: Check Step 5 rubric and prepare end-of-shift request
nodes.detail: While Claude builds the return-to-floor reports, switches to the Google Docs workflow-planning template to check Step 5's rubric, then returns to Claude and composes the request to check the post-return reassignment sheet for issues and prepare the charge-nurse end-of-shift report.

nodes.label: Review the updated RN-4 return assignment and audit results
nodes.detail: Reviews the delivered RN-4 return-to-floor acuity and nurse-assignment-audit reports (Rooms 115/116 reverted to RN-4, 16 patients/142 acuity) before sending the Step 5 request.

user_response.label: adopt
user_response.reasoning:
Source d4: Requests the same two reports for RN4's return to floor
Target d5: Outputs return to floor acuity and assignment-audit files with Rooms back to RN4.
Reasoning: New goal, not a refinement of d1; user accepts d5.

Step-5.step_name: Re-check the nurse assignment for issues and prepare a charge-nurse end-of-shift report.
Step-5.step_action: Check the nurse reassignment for issues as before. Determine if any issues warrant changing assignment in shift remaining. Prepare charge nurse end-of-shift report.

nodes.label: Request final assignment check and end-of-shift report
nodes.detail: Asks Claude to check the post-return nurse-reassignment sheet for issues warranting a change, recreate the assignment for the rest of the shift if needed, and prepare a charge-nurse end-of-shift report (end-of-shift.docx) covering the day's events, acuity totals, and staffing, finding at least 2 issues.

nodes.label: Diagnose end-of-shift issues and produce charge-nurse report
nodes.detail: Reviews the RN-4-returned assignment sheet, finds the charge-nurse hierarchy inverted (RN-4 had fewer patients than RN-1) and corrects it by moving Room 107 from RN-1 to RN-4, and determines RN-2's sustained isolation/acuity load should be a handoff note rather than a same-shift reassignment; drafts, renders to PDF, visually verifies, and delivers the two-page end-of-shift.docx (summary, acuity totals, roster, handoff notes).

nodes.label: Review end-of-shift report
nodes.detail: Reads through the delivered end-of-shift.docx (summary, acuity totals, roster, handoff notes) before requesting the matching final Excel deliverables.

nodes.label: Request recreation of final XLSX deliverables
nodes.detail: Asks Claude to recreate the nursing-assignment xlsx file and the final patient-acuity xlsx file specifically for the end of shift.

nodes.label: Rebuild final end-of-shift Excel deliverables
nodes.detail: Builds patientacuity-end-of-shift.xlsx and nurse-assignment-audit-end-of-shift.xlsx reflecting the Room 107 fix, verifies both reconcile (16 patients/142 acuity) with all 6 audit checks passing including the previously-failing strict tie-check, and delivers both files.

nodes.label: Review rebuilt end-of-shift deliverables
nodes.detail: Reviews the final patientacuity-end-of-shift.xlsx and nurse-assignment-audit-end-of-shift.xlsx files before requesting one last bottleneck check.

user_response.label: adopt
user_response.reasoning:
Source e1: Requests an issue check, updated assignment, and end-of-shift report.
Target e5: Outputs patientacuity-end-of-shift.xlsx and nurse-assignment-audit-end-of-shift.xlsx with e2's fix applied.
Reasoning: e2 delivers end-of-shift.docx but not the updated sheets. e4 asks again. User accepts e5.

nodes.label: Request final bottleneck recheck
nodes.detail: Asks Claude for a final recheck of any bottlenecks or issues and, if any warrant changes, to provide rationale.

nodes.label: Perform final cross-check and confirm no further reassignment needed
nodes.detail: Cross-checks that the 16 rooms match between the acuity and assignment files, re-verifies all 6 audit checks pass, and reviews workload patterns once more; confirms RN-2's isolation/acuity concentration remains a handoff-note item (not a reassignment) and flags RN-3's tied-highest patient count with both pending discharges as a new procedural handoff issue, not warranting reassignment this late in the shift.

nodes.label: Review complete set of session deliverables
nodes.detail: Scrolls back through the chat reviewing the full set of artifacts generated during the session (patient acuity reports, nurse assignment audits, and the end-of-shift report) as the recording concludes.

user_response.label: adopt
user_response.reasoning:
Source e7: Requests a final bottleneck check
Target e8: Outputs analysis and flags. 
Reasoning: User accepts e8
